component_selection_rule: for draw index i, component = components[SHA256(seed \0 namespace \0 'mixture-component' \0 i)-seeded Random.randrange(24)]; frozen before any case content is generated
historical_exclusion_conditional_law: For each draw index, select one component uniformly from the 24 components and select one target length uniformly in that component's regime. Freeze both values. Generate a prompt realization. If its prompt or token identity is in the fixed historical exclusion inventory, increment a case-local attempt nonce and regenerate only the prompt realization. Do not redraw the component or target length. Retain the accepted realization at the original draw index. Do not use quota balancing.
note: The calibration draw uses a public seed; the holdout draw uses an independent secret seed. Both use this identical component-selection rule and weights, so calibration and holdout cases are IID draws from one frozen mixture population, per issue #108 Q2.
target_length_selection_rule: for draw index i and selected regime r, length = SHA256(seed \0 namespace \0 'target-length' \0 r \0 i)-seeded Random.randint(low, high); each inclusive regime length is uniform
